g.text: I'm a software engineering student building production-shaped systems —
REST APIs, offline-sync platforms, and hardware-connected apps —
focused on backend architecture, data integrity, and clean design.
Clinical records system built for real-world unreliable connectivity — works offline, syncs when back online.
Hydration-tracking app pairing a mobile client with an Arduino-based hardware sensor.
Building reliable backend systems and full-stack applications,
status: open to freelance contracts AND full-time roles
